purpose: Display the Tesla account region, the Fleet API endpoint used by TeslaSync, and regional reference information.
primaryGoal: Inspect the resolved account region and endpoint, copy the complete base URL, and explicitly re-resolve the region from Tesla.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Account snapshot, not selected-vehicle telemetry or a workspace date-range aggregate.
dataSources.queryBehavior: userKeys.teslaRegion = ['tesla-user-region']; STALE_TIMES.STATIC; forwards AbortSignal; no vehicle or date parameters.
dataSources.backendLimit: Router registration inspected; handler, persistence, Tesla response guarantees, cache age and account authentication details were not traced or exercised.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing explicit account-region mutation; no production mutation performed.
dataSources.queryBehavior: Invalidates the existing region query on success and emits one hook-owned success/error toast. Router applies 5 requests per minute by IP.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing feature-owned derived display metadata and static NA/EU/CN reference descriptions.
dataSources.queryBehavior: URL parsing retains raw base URL; malformed URLs yield null host/protocol while attempting zone recognition. Unknown zones remain null.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing shared locale/unit/currency formatting and account snapshot-period adapters; not an additional region source.
dataSources.queryBehavior: Validates fetched_at before presenting snapshot time, uses relative time for the summary and existing preference-aware operational metric formatting.
dataSources.backendLimit: Formatting preference endpoints and deeper formatter internals were not inspected; no new physical-unit assumptions are needed for these text/status metrics.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: RegionEndpointPanel and the mounted RegionEndpointDetails contain equivalent endpoint state branches and metadata. The legacy barrel still exports the old renderer. The mounted page uses only the newer renderer; old renderer tests are not evidence for the mounted implementation.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep one feature presentation owner and a neutral feature prop contract; migrate relevant behavior tests before considering removal. Do not transplant the older fixed-white/decorative styling.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: RegionSummary and RegionKpiBand retain four-card presentations of the same region/status/protocol/sync concepts now owned by RegionOperationalBrief. They are not mounted by this page.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain the current OperationalBrief owner and all four identities; reconcile alternate callers and tests before retiring old renderers. Do not introduce another stat grid.

responsive.strategy: Three named sections remain mounted. Endpoint and reference stack below xl, then split 2:1 across three columns. Endpoint URL uses min-w-0/break-all and a wrapping region heading; metadata requests KVList responsive layout. Shared PageLayout keeps allocated width.

issues.detail: Refresh explicitly uses Button size sm, whose shared default height is h-9 (36px), below the stronger 44px mobile target. Icon-only CopyButton also defaults to sm. Actual rendered target spacing and exceptions are unverified.
issues.fix: Use existing Button/CopyButton props and mobile sizing classes for reachable targets, preserving compact desktop density; validate spacing and long translations rather than globally changing button defaults.

positiveEvidence: Decorative refresh icon hidden; pending header action disabled and aria-busy at TeslaRegionPage.tsx:62-69.
Copy URL has a localized accessible name at RegionEndpointDetails.tsx:29.
Reference list has aria-labelledby and native ul/li semantics at RegionAboutPanel.tsx:48-59.
Shared route-focus heading remains at PageContainer.tsx:190-198.
FadeIn honors the existing reduced-motion owner at FadeIn.tsx:24-33.

issues.detail: CopyButton receives a fixed ariaLabel and neither withToast nor onCopyError. The shared primitive prioritizes that fixed label even after success; clipboard failure only logs unless a feedback option is supplied. There is no source-confirmed user-visible failure feedback in this composition.
issues.fix: Reuse CopyButton with its existing withToast or onCopyError contract for localized actionable feedback; verify success announcements with the explicit action name rather than adding a second clipboard controller.

states.initialLoading: OperationalBrief receives loading only with no retained data; endpoint renders skeletons. Reference remains visible.
states.empty: When neither region nor URL is present, endpoint renders localized EmptyState and Refresh action.
states.fatalError: Only source.fatalError enters endpoint QueryError; GET retry remains separate from Tesla refresh mutation.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: deriveDataState preserves payload; endpoint remains populated; PageContainer source notice and account summary status convey degradation.
states.offline: Existing query/source contract handles paused reads; actual network/offline rendering unverified.
states.partial: Individual fields null-safe to placeholders, but semantic partial classification is not passed to deriveDataState.
states.mutation: Header refresh disables while pending and shows busy/spinning feedback; hook owns toast and invalidation.

issues.detail: deriveDataState receives no unavailable/partial options. A successful empty envelope or a snapshot missing one endpoint field is classified ok because envelope presence determines hasData. OperationalBrief can say Account snapshot available while endpoint shows No region on record; a partial endpoint can be labeled Configured without expressing missing metadata.
issues.fix: Derive feature-level unavailable/partial evidence from the existing payload and known backend contract, retaining every available field. Wire existing data-state/summary status owners; do not equate missing fields with zero or invent backend guarantees.

issues.detail: Empty-state Refresh has only onClick; pending mutation state is not part of RegionEndpointPanelProps. Header refresh disables, but this second trigger remains enabled during the same mutation.
issues.fix: Forward the existing mutation pending state through a feature contract and reuse shared action disabled/busy behavior for every trigger, preserving both entry points and the single toast owner.

visualIssues.detail: The informational reference heading uses decorative cyan IconBox. Its shared implementation consumes bg-neon-cyan/10 and ring-neon-cyan/20 rather than neutral reference chrome. No glow is applied by this IconBox; do not falsely report glowing text or borders.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer a plain muted decorative icon or the existing shared neutral icon treatment. Preserve all reference prose and zone rows; do not create another icon surface or reset saved themes.

architectureIssues.detail: getWorkspaceRouteScope('/tesla-region') resolves vehicle=true: this route is absent from VEHICLE_DISABLED_PATHS and does not match disabled prefixes. The actual region query is account-wide with no vehicle parameter, so the shell-owned vehicle picker conveys a scope that cannot affect this page. Range=false is appropriate for the account snapshot.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should add this exact account route to the existing vehicle-disabled registry after scope reconciliation. Do not add a page-local selector, local scope bypass or range control.

priority.rationale: Already uses current shared layouts and summary owners with retained-data protection. Prioritize contradictory empty/partial trust labels, consistent refresh pending behavior, truthful workspace scope, and action feedback before cosmetic cleanup.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Correct existing workspace scope for account-region route
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing getWorkspaceRouteScope returns { range: false, vehicle: false } for /tesla-region; no new selector API.
dependsOn: Reconcile exact account route registration at web\src\App.tsx:724

competingImplementations.decision: Reuse OperationalBrief and existing metric/preference pipeline; no new stats component. Alternates are not mounted here; other runtime callers were not proven absent.
Keep current LayoutCard/KVList/CopyButton implementation and consolidate feature contracts/tests without reverting to old presentation.

sections.name: Region overview
sections.contents: Region zone/description, endpoint configuration status and source, protocol and secure-transport context, last-sync relative time and account provenance.

sections.name: Fleet API endpoint
sections.contents: Full descriptive region, recognized zone badge, raw copyable base URL, region name, zone code, protocol, host and full timestamp; loading/error/empty recovery.

sections.name: About your region
sections.contents: Always-visible explanation of regional account homing and command/data routing; Fleet API zones subsection with ordered NA/EU/CN codes and full descriptions.

actions.behavior: Same POST handler; must remain reachable when no region is configured.

actions.behavior: GET refetch, separate from re-resolving via Tesla POST.

actions.behavior: Shared clipboard owner copies complete original baseUrl; appears when URL exists.

actions.name: Recover a failed or paused source
actions.behavior: Existing notice refetches only retryable sources.

dataBehavior: Preserve envelope fields, raw URL, query identity, cancellation, stale-time policy, invalidation and hook-owned toasts.
Keep zone inference and malformed/unknown URL behavior distinct from Tesla-provided region text.
Keep all available endpoint fields on background refresh failure; fatal errors alone may replace the endpoint content.
Keep unknown values as placeholders, not measured zeros; preserve known configuration and partial payload content.
Keep snapshot fetched_at, full and relative dates, localization, display preferences and valid-timestamp provenance.
No physical SI measurements are introduced or converted; raw wire/cache values remain unchanged.
Preserve named sections across all states and widths; no whole-page gate may hide the static reference.
No page export, chart, table, saved filter or selected-vehicle/date business scope was found in this inspected page.
